from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its title and which OTHER provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's full title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (may be empty; determined from other documents' reference lists)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
